classification.difficultyReason: Recognise equal angles standing on the same arc, then use the angle sum of a triangle containing the external point.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Two secants meet at an external point on the right. Crossing chords join opposite circumference points. The external angle is 20°, the lower-left angle is 30°, and x is the angle at the lower-right point between the chord towards the upper-left point and the secant towards the external point. No point names are printed.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left angle and the supplied lower-left 30° angle stand on the same arc. The triangle with vertices at the upper-left circumference point, lower-right circumference point and external point therefore has angles 30°, 20° and x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the givens 20°, 30° and the unknown x are visible; the source answer 130° is omitted.

answer.worked:
The upper-left circumference angle is $30^\circ$, because angles standing on the same arc are equal.

In the triangle joining the upper-left point, lower-right point and external point:
$$\begin{align*}x+30^\circ+20^\circ&=180^\circ\\x+50^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=130^\circ\end{align*}$$
